description: Create a dynamic config. Creates a new config with the given `schema`. The initial `value` (or an empty object) is published as version 1 on **every** env.

description.description: Optional free-form description shown in the dashboard. Max 512 chars.

dev.description: Seed the **dev** env's initial value (version 1), overriding `value` for dev. Published immediately. Must match `schema`.

folder.description: Optional folder name grouping items in the dashboard. Alphanumeric, `_` or `-` (no `/`). Part of the SDK lookup key (`<folder>/<name>`).

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `release_configs_list` call. It proves you listed existing release configs and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `release_configs_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

name.description: Stable config/killswitch key in `folder.name` form (two lowercase segments separated by a dot, e.g. `pricing.tiers`). Immutable after create.

prod.description: Seed the **prod** env's initial value (version 1), overriding `value` for prod. Published immediately. Must match `schema`.

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describing the shape of the config value. Top-level `type` must be `'object'`; every published value is validated against this schema.

staging.description: Seed the **staging** env's initial value (version 1), overriding `value` for staging. Published immediately. Must match `schema`.

value.description: Initial config value. Either a single JSON object applied to every env, or a `{ env: value }` map seeding per-env values. Must match `schema`. Defaults to `{}` on every env when omitted.

name: release_configs_create
